name: RmButton
description: Modern button: default / accent / outline / flat / link, image + text, split drop-down.

properties.name: Image
properties.description: Image file or a built-in glyph name (save, open, mail, settings ...).

properties.name: CornerRadius
properties.description: Corner radius in pixels (-1 = the theme's).

properties.name: DropDownItems
properties.description: Items of the split drop-down: a;b;c or JSON [{Text, Name}].

properties.name: Style
properties.description: Theme of this control: Inherit = the form's / application's Theme.

properties.name: EventItem
properties.description: Name of the item of the last item event (ItemClick, NodeClick ...).

properties.name: EventIndex
properties.description: Index of the item of the last item event.

events.name: Click
events.description: The button was clicked (or Space / Enter).

events.name: DropDownItemClicked
events.description: An item of the drop-down was picked (EventItem = its Name).

python-tk.notes: also draws the control for VB6 (vb-basic) and every GUI Bridge language; native C / C++ / Fortran exes use radforms/controls/rm_*.c
